verified_facts.text: The hotel is set within the Lenbachgärten quarter, close to the historic Königsplatz in Munich.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set within the verdant Lenbachgärten quarter and close to the historic Königsplatz

verified_facts.text: The hotel's address is Sophienstrasse 28, 80333 Munich.
Most of the suites overlook the Old Botanical Garden and the historic rooftops of Munich.
verified_facts.excerpt: most of our elegant suites overlook the Old Botanical Garden and the historic rooftops of Munich

verified_facts.text: Deluxe Panoramic View Rooms have views over Munich including the Old Botanical Garden and, on clear days, the Alps.
verified_facts.excerpt: offer outstanding views over Munich, including the Old Botanical Garden and, on clear days, the Alps

verified_facts.text: Deluxe Park View Rooms have French balconies and botanical accents inspired by the Old Botanical Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: inspired by the Old Botanical Garden, with French balconies and natural, botanical accents

verified_facts.text: The Lord Forte Suite has a private terrace with views of the Old Botanical Garden, Munich's rooftops and the Alps.
verified_facts.excerpt: Step onto your private terrace to take in sights of the Old Botanical Garden, Munich’s rooftops and the Alps.

verified_facts.text: The Monforte Royal Suite is named after Lord Forte's birthplace and has a private terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Monforte Royal Suite, named after Lord Forte’s birthplace, is our most distinguished residence, featuring a private terrace

verified_facts.text: Two-Bedroom Family Rooms have separate bedrooms for parents and children.
verified_facts.excerpt: with separate bedrooms for parents and children

verified_facts.text: Florio serves classic Italian food with a menu created by Fulvio Pierangelini.
verified_facts.excerpt: in a menu created by Fulvio Pierangelini

verified_facts.text: Florio has a dining room and terrace with views over the Old Botanical Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: The restaurant's verdant dining room and terrace with views over the Old Botanical Garden

verified_facts.text: Florio Bar is an Italian aperitivo bar with a plant-filled interior and botanical frescoes leading to the terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: The art of italian aperitivo. A softly lit interior of plants and botanical frescoes lead seamlessly to the terrace

verified_facts.text: Circle Bar is named in homage to Mauro Staccioli's Ring sculpture outside the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Paying homage to both Mauro Staccioli’s iconic _Ring_ sculpture outside our hotel

verified_facts.text: Circle Bar has an Art Deco backdrop by Paolo Moschino and a library of books.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the sleek comfort of Paolo Moschino’s Art Deco backdrop, enjoy the buzz of lively conversation or pour over a vintage novel from our library.

verified_facts.text: Circle Bar's Champagne list includes both internationally renowned labels and boutique producers.
verified_facts.excerpt: showcasing both internationally renowned labels and boutique producers

verified_facts.text: There is no dress code in the restaurants, but guests are asked to avoid sportswear, shorts and beach shoes; smart-casual is typical.
verified_facts.excerpt: refrain from wearing sportswear, shorts and beach shoes in our restaurants. Our guests within the hotel usually opt for a smart-casual style

verified_facts.text: The hotel hosts meetings and events from galas to business meetings.
verified_facts.excerpt: From a grand gala to an intimate business meeting, we host every occasion with great style.
